title: The Woman Who Burned Up in Space — Who Never Existed

scenes.voiceover: In 1961, two Italian brothers recorded a woman dying in space. Officially, she never existed.
scenes.visualConcept: Reel-to-reel tape machine in the dark, VU-meter menace.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Reel-to-reel tape machine in the dark, VU-meter menace.

scenes.voiceover: Their homemade listening station outside Turin had tracked real Soviet spacecraft for years. They knew what a mission sounded like.
scenes.mainText: THEY TRACKED REAL SPACECRAFT FOR YEARS
scenes.visualConcept: Vintage shortwave radio gear — the credibility beat.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Vintage shortwave radio gear — the credibility beat.

scenes.voiceover: Then they caught a female voice, in Russian, growing desperate. I am hot. I am hot. Am I going to crash?
scenes.mainText: "I AM HOT. AM I GOING TO CRASH?"
scenes.visualConcept: Tape reels spinning — the words land one by one like a transmission.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Tape reels spinning — the words land one by one like a transmission.

scenes.voiceover: That was two years before the first woman officially flew to space. Moscow's answer: no launch, no cosmonaut, no voice.
scenes.mainText: 2 YEARS TOO EARLY. "NO LAUNCH. NO VOICE."
scenes.visualConcept: Dark Earth from orbit — an empty sky where a ship should be.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Dark Earth from orbit — an empty sky where a ship should be.

scenes.voiceover: Experts say the tape doesn't hold up. But here's the problem. That exact year, the Soviet Union really was hiding dead spacemen.
scenes.mainText: THE USSR REALLY WAS HIDING DEAD SPACEMEN
scenes.visualConcept: The real cosmonaut group photo — the proven erasures behind the myth.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: The real cosmonaut group photo — the proven erasures behind the myth.

scenes.voiceover: Six real men, erased from history. That full story is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: THE 6 REAL ERASURES → ON THE CHANNEL
scenes.visualConcept: Tape machine, reels still turning — the loop back to the hook.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Tape machine, reels still turning — the loop back to the hook.
